thread.title: Nikkei rises, weaker yen and strong corporate earnings boost sentiment

author: nasdaq.com
title: Nikkei rises, weaker yen and strong corporate earnings boost sentiment
text:
Shutterstock photo
* Nikkei up 0.5 pct, Topix gains 0.55 pct
* Blue chips such as Sharp, Sony and Nintendo up on solidearnings
* Apple-linked shares gain after iPhone maker posts strongresults
By Shinichi Saoshiro
TOKYO, Aug 1 (Reuters) - Japan's Nikkei share average roseon Wednesday, supported by a stronger Wall Street and a weakeryen, with blue chips such as Sony and Sharp gaining on strongearnings and lifting overall sentiment.
The Nikkei .N225 was up 0.5 percent at 22,672.63.
"The gains by U.S. shares and the yen's depreciation aresupportive for the Nikkei. It has become easier for the marketto focus on such supportive factors with the Bank of Japan'spolicy meeting over," said Yutaka Miura, senior technicalanalyst at Mizuho Securities.
The Dow .DJI climbed 0.43 percent and the S&P 500 .SPX advanced roughly 0.50 percent overnight, boosted by gains inindustrial shares. .N
The dollar traded around 111.76 yenJPY= , having ralliedfrom a low of 110.75 after the BOJ tweaked monetary policy onTuesday but pledged to keep rates low for an extended period.
Reports that the Trump administration plans to proposeslapping a 25 percent tariff on $200 billion of Chinese imports,after initially setting them at 10 percent, were taken in stridefor now, with Chinese shares gaining and dollar/yen largelystable. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL1N1US02F
Robust corporate results from abroad and at home helped lifta variety of shares on Tuesday.
Sony Corp6758.T rose 4.8 percent after the companyreported record first quarter profit thanks to a surge in thesales of game software. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL4N1UR3FX
Supported by strong sales of Switch game titles, Nintendo Co7974.T reported a better-than-expected 88 percent jump infirst quarter operating profit and the company's shares were up5.6 percent. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL4N1UR3UL
Sharp Corp6753.T gained 6.2 percent after its firstquarter operating profit soared 45 percent on the back of itscore display business and strong sales of camera modules andsensors. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL4N1UR3G4
Apple-linked AAPL.O shares also advanced after the iPhonemaker posted quarterly results that topped Wall Street targetsand forecast above-expected revenue in the current quarter. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL1N1UN20N
Electronic component maker Kyocera Corp6971.T rose 6percent and display manufacturer Nitto Denko Corp6988.T added5.5 percent.
Declining shares included semiconductor maker RenesasElectronics 6723.T , which slumped more than 7 percent. Thecompany posted a rise in operating profit for the six monthsthrough June but forecast a decline for the year throughDecember. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nXB1MDJE0H
The broader Topix .TOPX gained 0.55 percent to 1,762.92. (Editing by Shri Navaratnam) (( shinichi.saoshiro@thomsonreuters.com ; Reuters Messaging: shinichi.saoshiro.reuters.com@reuters.net ))
